# HitchMath

Towing math for US truck and SUV owners. Calculators that show their work and vehicle towing tables copied from manufacturer documents.

## Pages
- [Towing capacity calculator: can my truck tow it?](https://hitchmath.com/towing-capacity-calculator/): Run all five towing checks together and see the first limit you would hit.
- [Payload calculator: how much can my truck carry?](https://hitchmath.com/payload-calculator/): Add people, cargo, accessories and tongue weight against your payload.
- [Tongue weight calculator](https://hitchmath.com/tongue-weight-calculator/): Tongue weight range, a measured-weight check, and the bathroom-scale method.
- [GCWR calculator: combined truck and trailer weight](https://hitchmath.com/gcwr-calculator/): Compare loaded truck plus trailer with GCWR, both directions.
- [Toyota Tacoma towing capacity (2026): every trim and configuration](https://hitchmath.com/toyota-tacoma-towing-capacity/): All 27 configurations of the 2026 Tacoma with payload, GVWR and tongue limit.
- [Ford F-150 towing capacity (2026): by engine, axle and package](https://hitchmath.com/ford-f150-towing-capacity/): Every 2026 F-150 engine with max tow, payload and the GCWR rows behind them.
- [Toyota Tundra towing capacity (2026): every trim and configuration](https://hitchmath.com/toyota-tundra-towing-capacity/): All 32 configurations of the 2026 Tundra with payload and GVWR.
- [Ram 1500 towing capacity (2026): every engine](https://hitchmath.com/ram-1500-towing-capacity/): Every 2026 Ram 1500 engine with max tow and payload from Ram’s chart.
- [Chevy Silverado 1500 towing capacity (2026): every engine, cab and box](https://hitchmath.com/chevy-silverado-1500-towing-capacity/): Every 2026 Silverado 1500 engine, cab and box with GCWR.
- [Toyota 4Runner towing capacity (2026): every trim](https://hitchmath.com/toyota-4runner-towing-capacity/): All 16 versions of the 2026 4Runner with payload computed from Toyota specs.
- [Ford Maverick towing capacity (2026): hybrid and EcoBoost](https://hitchmath.com/ford-maverick-towing-capacity/): Every 2026 Maverick engine and package with GCWR from Ford’s 2026 guide.
- [Toyota Highlander towing capacity (2026): gas vs hybrid](https://hitchmath.com/toyota-highlander-towing-capacity/): Every 2026 Highlander grade with payload computed from Toyota’s specs.
- [Toyota RAV4 towing capacity (2026): FWD vs AWD](https://hitchmath.com/toyota-rav4-towing-capacity/): Every 2026 RAV4 grade and drive with payload from Toyota’s specs.
- [Ford Ranger towing capacity (2026): every engine](https://hitchmath.com/ford-ranger-towing-capacity/): Every 2026 Ranger engine with GCWR from Ford’s 2026 guide.
- [Honda Ridgeline towing capacity (2026): every trim](https://hitchmath.com/honda-ridgeline-towing-capacity/): All four 2026 Ridgeline trims with payload, GVWR and GCWR from Honda.
- [Chevy Colorado towing capacity (2026): every package](https://hitchmath.com/chevy-colorado-towing-capacity/): Every 2026 Colorado package with GCWR from Chevrolet’s 2026 guide.
- [Ford Bronco towing capacity (2026): every trim](https://hitchmath.com/ford-bronco-towing-capacity/): Every 2026 Bronco engine, axle and door count with GCWR from Ford’s guide.
- [Ford Explorer towing capacity (2026): every engine](https://hitchmath.com/ford-explorer-towing-capacity/): Every 2026 retail Explorer engine and drive with GCWR from Ford’s guide.
- [Honda Pilot towing capacity (2026): 2WD vs AWD](https://hitchmath.com/honda-pilot-towing-capacity/): Every 2026 Pilot trim and drive with curb weight from Honda’s specs.
- [Subaru Outback towing capacity (2026): every trim](https://hitchmath.com/subaru-outback-towing-capacity/): Every 2026 Outback trim with curb weight from Subaru’s comparison sheet.
- [GVWR: what it means and how to use it](https://hitchmath.com/gvwr/): What GVWR means, where to find it, and how to turn it into payload.
- [Ford Expedition towing capacity (2026): SWB and MAX](https://hitchmath.com/ford-expedition-towing-capacity/): Every 2026 Expedition configuration with GCWR and hitch limits from Ford’s 2026 guide.
- [Chevy Tahoe towing capacity (2026): every engine](https://hitchmath.com/chevy-tahoe-towing-capacity/): Every 2026 Tahoe engine and drive with GCWR from Chevrolet’s 2026 guide.
- [Chevy Suburban towing capacity (2026): every engine](https://hitchmath.com/chevy-suburban-towing-capacity/): Every 2026 Suburban engine and drive with GCWR from Chevrolet’s 2026 guide.
- [Chevy Traverse towing capacity (2026): with and without V92](https://hitchmath.com/chevy-traverse-towing-capacity/): Every 2026 Traverse drive and package with GCWR from Chevrolet’s 2026 guide.
- [Jeep Wrangler towing capacity (2026): 2-door, 4-door and Rubicon](https://hitchmath.com/jeep-wrangler-towing-capacity/): Every 2026 Wrangler trim with payload, base weight and GCWR from Jeep’s specs.
- [Nissan Frontier towing capacity (2026): every cab and bed](https://hitchmath.com/nissan-frontier-towing-capacity/): Every 2026 Frontier cab and bed with payload and tongue load from Nissan.
- [Subaru Ascent towing capacity (2026): every trim](https://hitchmath.com/subaru-ascent-towing-capacity/): Every 2026 Ascent trim with curb weight from Subaru’s comparison sheet.
- [Kia Telluride towing capacity (2027): gas and hybrid](https://hitchmath.com/kia-telluride-towing-capacity/): Every 2027 Telluride trim with GVWR and payload from Kia’s specs, gas and hybrid.
- [Ram 2500 towing capacity (2026): HEMI and Cummins](https://hitchmath.com/ram-2500-towing-capacity/): Every 2026 Ram 2500 cab and axle with payload, for any hitch, from Ram’s chart.
- [Ram 3500 towing capacity (2026): SRW and dually](https://hitchmath.com/ram-3500-towing-capacity/): Every 2026 Ram 3500 cab, bed and axle with payload, for any hitch, from Ram’s chart.
- [Chevy Silverado 2500 HD towing capacity (2026)](https://hitchmath.com/chevy-silverado-2500hd-towing-capacity/): Every 2026 Silverado 2500 HD model with conventional and gooseneck ratings, from Chevrolet.
- [Chevy Silverado 3500 HD towing capacity (2026)](https://hitchmath.com/chevy-silverado-3500hd-towing-capacity/): Every 2026 Silverado 3500 HD model with conventional and gooseneck ratings, from Chevrolet.
